name: proctype-with-argument
source: active proctype Ping(byte x) { x = 1; } init { run Ping(2); }

name: channels
source: chan q = [2] of {byte}; init { byte x; q ! 1; q ? x; }

name: user-defined-type
source: typedef Packet { byte id }; Packet p; init { p.id = 2; }

name: inline-definition
source: inline inc(x) { x = x + 1; } init { int n; inc(n); }

name: guarded-option-assignment
source: byte n; init { if :: n > 0 -> n = n - 1; :: else -> skip; fi; }

name: ltl-temporal-implication
source: int a; int b; ltl p { [] ((a > 0) -> (b > 0)) }

name: preprocessor-conditional
